subject: SimplyBank trial: fit/eval summary, regression alert and action plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@simplybank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: SimplyBank trial recap + recommended evals and next steps

Hi Emily / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and my recommended next steps for the two-week trial we kicked off: 

1) What we heard on the call
- Primary goal: improve customer support auto-tagging + intent classification for mortgage product pipeline (high precision for decline reasons).
- Current pain: sensitivity to subtle phrasing after yesterday's upstream model refresh; a handful of regression cases flagged by your QA.
- Success metrics: F1 uplift on intents, reduce false positive rate for "escalate to human" by 30%.

2) Redwood recommendations for fit / evals
- Models to evaluate (first pass): "redwood/gpt-4o-mini@2026-11-04" (recommended baseline), and "llama-2-13b-q8" for lower-cost inference.
- Eval artifacts: I attached trial_prompt_set_v1.json (prompt templates + per-intent test cases).
- Benchmarks: runs on your seed set are available here: https://benchmarks.redwood.com/simplybank/trial-2026-11

3) Quality/regression guardrails
- Immediate mitigation: we can pin your trial to a specific model version to prevent auto-roll updates. Pinning options: model version pin OR route 100% of traffic to a vetted variant.
- Longer-term: run out-of-band regression diffs each night and wire alerts for >5% token-level delta on critical intents.

4) Next steps / asks
- Emily: confirm the subset of 200 priority examples you want included in the nightly diff by EOD Thursday (2026-11-19).
- Rishi / Monica: we'll prepare an eval pack and a rollback/pinning playbook for your infra team.

Attachments: trial_prompt_set_v1.json (application/json)

I'll follow up with a concrete pin/rollback proposal once we get your sample subset.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@simplybank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@simplybank.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SimplyBank trial: fit/eval summary, regression alert and action plan

Thanks Rishi — useful recap. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Regression we saw: after an automatic model variant push on 2026-11-17, several of our mortgage decline reasons changed wording and the QA team flagged 18/300 examples where the classifier now suggests "escalate to human" incorrectly. I've attached a short PDF with examples (sample_responses.pdf).

2) Can you confirm: if we pin to a specific model version, will we stop receiving updates from Redwood's hosted catalog? We need assurances that the pinned model won't change without an explicit action. Also, what's the rollback SLA if we choose to revert to a previous version?

3) Please include the nightly diffs you mentioned and any quick smoke tests we can run in our staging cluster.

We already pulled out 250 priority examples — I'll share the set via the Drive link you gave once I finish redacting PII.

Thanks,
Emily Jones
PM, Customer Experience — SimplyBank
emily.jones@simplybank.com

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 2:05 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message omitted]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@simplybank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T18:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SimplyBank trial: fit/eval summary, regression alert and action plan

Emily —

Appreciate the quick examples, that PDF helped. Short answers first: yes — a model pin will freeze the model version for your trial endpoint (no automatic catalog updates), and we can execute a rollback within our incident window (we typically target a configurable 2–4 hour rollback for pinned endpoints with an agreed SLA on Dedicated/Private plans; for hosted trials we'll commit to a same-day rollback and prioritized routing).

Proposed immediate action (can execute today if you approve):
- Pin your trial endpoint to redwood/gpt-4o-mini@2026-11-04 (we used this in our baseline runs).
- Run the sb_eval_pack_v2.zip against your 250-priority examples in a sandbox; I attached the pack. It contains: golden answers, scorer, and an auto-diff script that highlights regression tokens and intent-flips.
- Nightly diffs: we will run the auto-diff and post a short report to the Drive folder and trigger an alert if >5% of critical intents flip.

Recommended model alternatives and tradeoffs:
- "redwood/gpt-4o-mini@2026-11-04" — best match to your current QA (higher precision, slightly higher cost).
- "llm/llama-2-13b-q8" — cheaper, good baseline for non-critical workloads but we observed slight recall drops on some intent edge cases in our bench runs.

Links and artifacts:
- Eval pack (attached): sb_eval_pack_v2.zip (application/zip)
- Prompt set / quick edit gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/simplybank-promptset-v1
- Benchmark summary: https://benchmarks.redwood.com/simplybank/trial-2026-11
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DB-4287

If you give the green light, I'll schedule the pin and kick off the sandbox run tonight. If you prefer a canary, we can route 20% of traffic to the pinned version and keep 80% on the catalog variant while we observe diff telemetry for 24 hours.

Which option do you prefer (full pin now / canary / run eval first)?

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: SimplyBank trial — pinning + rollback ops

Rishi / Aditya —

Quick internal note before I action the pin: we should offer two operational paths to SimplyBank and document them in the ticket: 

A) Emergency full pin + rollback path
- Pin to redwood/gpt-4o-mini@2026-11-04, disable auto-catalog updates for their trial endpoint.
- Pre-stage rollback image (previous stable snapshot) and validate KV-cache compatibility.
- SLA: 4-hour rollback for hosted trial (escalate to infra on-call if longer).

B) Canary + nightly diffs (recommended for low-risk)
- Route 20% traffic to pinned variant, 80% to latest catalog.
- Nightly diff report to Drive + pager if critical-intent-flips > 5%.

Operational items for the ticket:
- Run sb_eval_pack_v2.zip in sandbox and post results to the Drive folder.
- Add a prompt-set quick edit to the gist so they can iterate without re-deploying.
- Confirm we redact tokens in logs for PII (Emily is redacting examples).

I'll prepare the internal runbook and submit the action via the Ops portal after Rishi confirms which path SimplyBank chooses.

-Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
